gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-spectral-sc: Literary and a little bookish, Spectral SC sets sturdy hairlines beside moderate stems under Bruno Ace, whose line looks ruler-drawn. And the heading's constant-width strokes, like bent wire, make the body's lightly engraved brass feel almost handmade; at a large size the heading would carry more weight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-stix-two-text: STIX Two Text keeps its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks, with terminals pulled back from each curve. But Bruno Ace has no swelling in its bowls at all, so the text serif's quiet shifts read as warm and traditional beside it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Distinctive and wiry, Bruno Ace lingers one character per beat, like following a single thread. Tai Heritage Pro, a text serif with a measured thick-thin ratio and a clear channel into each round letter, gives that thread somewhere dignified to land.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-taviraj: Taviraj reads bookish and editorial, with generous gaps where curves end and soft thickness shifts that never turn stark. Bruno Ace, with round letters whose rims match the stems, earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-trirong: Dignified and bookish, Trirong flares its curve ends gently and varies its strokes like a sharpened carpenter's pencil line, against Bruno Ace's bent pipe cleaner texture. Their strongest quality is that tension between wire and taper.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-trocchi: Laser-etched lines meet ring-shaped curves here, since Bruno Ace traces everything in one constant width while Trocchi opens its c wide. The heading does distinctive, expressive display best; the serif body does dignified, medium-contrast text best.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-trykker: Trykker reads literary and refined, its open counters breathing into the white space with a mellow, understated modulation. Bruno Ace, whose o has sides and top equally thick, looks best at a generous size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-uchen: Flat and stencil-cut up top, soft below. Bruno Ace holds every stroke to a single weight while Uchen's serif curves welcome the eye, and that gap between rigid and gentle is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-vollkorn-sc: Vollkorn SC reads literary and loosely tracked, a classic serif with medium contrast and terminals cut short of the bowl. Bruno Ace excels at expressive, wire-straight display lines with diagonals as thick as horizontals, while Vollkorn SC handles gentle, dignified running text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-ibm-plex-serif: IBM Plex Serif reads authoritative, with slimmer horizontals and an unclenched c. Beside Bruno Ace's tubular, wire-like letters, that classic serif would carry a long passage with a lightly swelling, steady rhythm.
